metadata.title: IndologyScholars: Russian Indological Research Archive — Zograf and Roerich Readings Conference Corpus (2004–2026)
metadata.description: A structured, open-access dataset of 1,362 conference presentations, 268 scholar profiles, and 1,388 author participations drawn from the published programs of the Zograf Readings (St. Petersburg, 2004–2026) and Roerich Readings (Moscow, 2007–2025), with a curated historical prosopographical layer of 26 pre-contemporary Russian Indologists. Includes normalized speaker identities, institutional affiliations with explicit provenance tagging, thematic classification (L1/L2), three-level argument-scale coding (G1–G3), video-record mapping, and external authority identifiers (Wikidata, ORCID, OpenAlex). Formats: SQLite (conferences.db), JSON (site_data.json), 100+ analytics CSV exports, RDF/Turtle knowledge graph, Frictionless Data Package manifest, and a SHA-256 snapshot manifest. Companion data paper: Gasūns, M. (2026), Russian Indological Research Archive: A Conference Corpus for Prosopography, Research Data Journal for the Humanities and Social Sciences (submission pending).
